mapper.select: SELECT * FROM plans WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id,start_date,end_date,status FROM plans WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM plans WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM plans WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT p.*,c.id IS NOT NULL AS completed,c.checked_at FROM plan_items p LEFT JOIN checkins c ON c.item_id=p.id AND c.date=p.date WHERE p.plan_id=#{planId} AND p.retired=FALSE ORDER BY p.date,p.time,p.id

SELECT i.id,i.date,i.time,i.title,c.id IS NOT NULL AS completed,i.missed_reason FROM plan_items i LEFT JOIN checkins c ON c.item_id=i.id AND c.date=i.date WHERE i.plan_id=#{planId} AND i.retired=FALSE AND i.date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} ORDER BY i.date,i.time,i.id
mapper.update: UPDATE plan_items SET missed_reason=#{reason} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE plans SET status=#{status} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT i.plan_id,i.date FROM plan_items i JOIN plans p ON p.id=i.plan_id WHERE p.user_id=#{userId} AND i.id=#{id}
SELECT id,plan_id,date FROM plan_items WHERE id=#{id} AND retired=FALSE FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version),0) FROM plan_revisions WHERE plan_id=#{planId}
SELECT * FROM plan_revisions WHERE plan_id=#{planId} AND status IN ('DRAFT','CONFIRMED') ORDER BY version DESC
SELECT * FROM plan_revisions WHERE plan_id=#{planId} AND version=#{version}
mapper.update: UPDATE plan_revisions SET status='DISCARDED',note='',content_json=NULL WHERE plan_id=#{planId} AND status='DRAFT'
UPDATE plan_revisions SET status='DISCARDED',note='',content_json=NULL WHERE plan_id=#{planId} AND version=#{version} AND status='DRAFT'
UPDATE plan_revisions SET status='CONFIRMED',content_json=#{contentJson} WHERE plan_id=#{planId} AND version=#{version}
UPDATE plan_items SET retired=TRUE WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id,TRUE AS completed,checked_at AS checkedAt FROM checkins WHERE item_id=#{itemId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id,task_id,title,start_date,end_date,created_at,source_deleted,source_change,include_diary,report_type,report_version, metric,comparison_start_date,comparison_end_date FROM reports WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC
SELECT * FROM reports WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id=#{id}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(report_version),0)+1 FROM reports WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND report_type=#{type} AND start_date=#{start} AND end_date=#{end}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS scheduled,COUNT(c.id) AS completed FROM plans p JOIN plan_items i ON i.plan_id=p.id LEFT JOIN checkins c ON c.item_id=i.id AND c.date=i.date WHERE p.user_id=#{userId} AND i.retired=FALSE AND i.date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}
mapper.update: UPDATE reports SET source_deleted=TRUE,source_change=#{change},title='源记录已变更，报告已失效', content=NULL,statistics_json=NULL,references_json=NULL WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND report_type <> 'SLEEP' AND source_deleted=FALSE AND ((start_date <= #{end} AND end_date >= #{start}) OR (comparison_start_date <= #{end} AND comparison_end_date >= #{start}))

UPDATE reports SET source_deleted=TRUE,source_change=#{change},title='源记录已变更，报告已失效', content=NULL,statistics_json=NULL,references_json=NULL WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND source_deleted=FALSE AND (metric='HEART_RATE' OR JSON_CONTAINS(statistics_json, JSON_OBJECT('key', 'HEART_RATE'), '$.metrics')) AND (#{date} BETWEEN start_date AND end_date OR #{date} BETWEEN comparison_start_date AND comparison_end_date)
